thread:
sara_cs: FYI customer reported 400 on /v1/toolcall when sending a payload with an embedded tab character inside a string. Repro + logs below.

user_acme_support: Sending over an example payload — they pasted from a Windows tool that inserts tabs. It fails every time.

sara_cs: Example payload (note there's a literal tab between "path:" and "C:\\Users\\..."). Repro steps:
```
POST /v1/toolcall
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tool": "file-reader",
  "args": "{\"path:\\t\"C:\\Users\\Bob\\notes.txt\"}"
}
```
Server response:
400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "Invalid JSON: unexpected control character at position 34"
}

kevin_infra: :eyes: That inner string has a literal tab (0x09). JSON strings must escape control chars. Which client is sending this?

user_acme_support: It's their Java app using ObjectMapper.writeValueAsString but they then wrap again and use string replace that accidentally expands \t into literal tab in one step.

ben_platform: Quick repro with curl shows same. Curl example:
```
curl -X POST ... --data-binary $'{"tool":"file-reader","args":"{\"path:\\t\"C:\\Users\\Bob\\notes.txt\"}"}'
```
That $'...' causes shell to convert \t -> actual tab. Don't do that.

sara_cs: Customer used that $'...' pattern in a deploy script. Workaround: ensure you send \\t (two characters in JSON: backslash + t) so the server receives backslash + t. e.g.:
```
{"tool":"file-reader","args":"{\"path:\\\\t\"C:\\Users\\Bob\\notes.txt\"}"}
```
(note: in many layers you may need to escape multiple times)

kevin_infra: Ops: ticketing - opened INF-8234 to surface better error message. Plan:
- Short term: update error to say "control character (tab) in string at pos X - please escape as \\t" (ben + sara)
- Mid term: SDKs should sanitize/escape control chars before sending (ben)
- Long term: consider server-side tolerant pre-scan to reject with 422 and hint (kevin)

ben_platform: Can't silently accept because could mask injection. :+1: on clearer message & SDK fix.

ops-bot: INF-8234 created by kevin_infra. Owner: ben_platform. Priority: P2.

sara_cs: Raised to customer, gave workaround + ETA for SDK patch. Closing loop once SDK release. :white_check_mark:
